title: 第15章 十道金牌强逼出战第16章 边军同生共死燃尽了我呀
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 【第十五年，三十二岁。
【开始词条抽取……】
【抽取成功！
【「羽毛球高手」（白）：你的右臂力气是你左臂的两倍，臂围也是，如果你是左撇子，则反过来。
【是否调整词条？】
【是否】
“这个白色词条还挺有用的，和‘认真的一拳’组合起来，等于能打出常态二十倍的拳力！”
不过陈奕瞄了一眼目前携带的词条，好像都替换不了。
“模拟器”
必须装备，不然模拟会停下。
“低阶根骨”
必须装备，不然没法修炼。
“过目不忘”
，本局MVP，肯定不能摘。
“认真的一拳”
，战斗力的保障。
唯一可以替换的，其实只有“努力必有收获”
，但和“羽毛球高手”
相比，陈奕还是更希望前者额继续发挥作用，虽然不多。
【一转眼，你在军营中又度过了十年。
【在海量丹药和晶石的帮助下，你的修为相比之前，可谓是坐上了火箭，已经提升到了炼体九段的巅峰，距离聚灵只差临门一脚。
【但是这一脚，踢了两年还没踢进去。
【孙承恩说有一种叫聚灵丹的丹药，能帮助你这种根骨差的人突破聚灵境。
【你估摸着，应该是类似修仙里筑基丹的东西。
【但是这两年战事不断，南疆大食国发起的大规模战争一场接着一场，苏州边军忙于打仗。
【孙承恩随便找了个名目，向军需处申请了聚灵丹，但一直没人给送过来。
【可能送来了，但因为边境战火纷飞，不知道送哪去了。
【如今，你们也没时间考虑突破境界的问题了。
【苏州，衍关。
content_en:
[Fifteenth year, thirty-two years old.
[Start extracting terms...]
[Extraction successful!
["Badminton Master" (white): Your right arm is twice as strong as your left arm, and the arm circumference is also the same. If you are left-handed, the reverse is true.
[Do you want to adjust the entry? 】
【Whether】
"This white entry is quite useful. Combined with 'Serious Punch', it can equal to twenty times the normal punching power!"
However, Chen Yi glanced at the entries he was currently carrying and found that none of them seemed to be replaceable.
"emulator"
Must be equipped, otherwise the simulation will stop.
"Low-level Root Bone"
It must be equipped, otherwise you will not be able to practice.
“Photographic memory”
, the MVP of this game will definitely not be picked.
"A serious punch"
, the guarantee of combat effectiveness.
The only thing that can be replaced is actually "hard work will pay off"
, but with "Badminton Master"
In comparison, Chen Yi still hopes that the former will continue to play a role, although not much.
[In the blink of an eye, you have spent another ten years in the military camp.
[With the help of massive pills and crystal stones, your cultivation level can be said to be on a rocket compared to before. You have reached the peak of the ninth stage of body refining, and you are only one step away from gathering souls.
[But this kick has not gone in after two years.
[Sun Chengen said that there is a pill called the Spirit Gathering Pill, which can help people with weak abilities like you break through the Spirit Gathering Realm.
[You estimate, it should be something similar to the Foundation Establishment Pill in Xiu Xian.
[However, wars have continued in the past two years. Large-scale wars launched by the food country in southern Xinjiang have been launched one after another. The Suzhou border army is busy fighting.
[Sun Chengen randomly found a name and applied for the Spirit Gathering Pill from the Military Supplies Department, but no one ever sent it.
[Maybe it was sent, but because of the war on the border, I don’t know where it was sent.
[Now, you don’t have time to think about breaking through the realm.
[Suzhou, Yanguan.
title_en: Chapter 15 Ten Gold Medals Forced to Fight Chapter 16 The Border Army Lives and Dies Together Burns Me Out
